snippet.title: Chalk Paper Scissors Trailer
snippet.description:
chalkpaperscissors.itch.io/chalk-paper-scissors

Chalk Paper Scissors is a visual novel/sidescroller game about embracing your inner child! Estranged childhood friends, Chalk, Paper, and Scissors, stumble into each other on a rainy day. As they reminisce and banter, they argue over who is responsible for losing their precious shared childhood plushie, Stuffie! Explore each character's memories to find out exactly what happened that fateful night all those years ago...

Made by BFA Animation/Illustration students at SJSU

Trailer edited by Citlali Navarro
Music by Jaydon Currier
